name: consumer-rights-cell
purpose: Answers questions about the Consumer Rights Act 2015, Part 1 from its own text only: the best-supported sentence, word for word, with its passage and character offsets. Refuses questions outside its lane.

lane.accepts: a question about the Consumer Rights Act 2015, Part 1
lane.refuses: questions whose words the the Consumer Rights Act 2015, Part 1 text does not use

interface.in: {"question":"<text>"} to ask (node genome/act.mjs); an answer record {question,source,start,end,text} to audit
interface.out: a verified answer record (passage id, character offsets, the exact sentence), or a refusal that says why

judge.what: an answer record is right when its text is exactly the cited passage's characters at its offsets and that passage uses at least the lane share of the question's content words

good.question: Where is oral implied explained?
good.text: (2) It applies whether the contract is written or oral or implied from the parties' conduct, or more than one of these combined.

bad.question: Where is oral implied explained?
bad.text: (2) It apply whether the contract is written or oral or implied from the parties' conduct, or more than one of these combined.

outOfLane.question: What is the best pizza topping?
